title: Guardian.JAR
body:
This resource pack retextures Guardians to give them a scarier look, drawing from Sonic.EXE, yeah that one prick with blue spines and bloody pupils.

Ever heard of Sonic.exe? dont read it, its so generic, okay maybe do its pretty funny to laugh at how bad the original creepypasta is. ehh whatever, screw this im off to read homestuck

Features:
- Turns Guardians into those stupid sonic.exes that have been appearing recently.
- And literally just changes them into evil guardians.
- Like really EVIL ones (cosmetically).
